title: Gaussian Naive Bayes
signature: def gaussian_nb(X_train: np.ndarray, y_train: np.ndarray, X_test: np.ndarray, var_smoothing: float = 1e-9) -> tuple
hints: Per class, fit the prior count/n, the per-feature mean, and the per-feature population variance (ddof=0). Add epsilon = var_smoothing * max(X_train.var(axis=0)) to every variance.
Work in log space: log prior - 0.5 * sum(log(2 pi var) + (x - mu)^2 / var), summed over features.
Normalize with log-sum-exp across classes. Exponentiating joint log-likelihoods around -1e4 underflows to 0 / 0.
